thread:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGER: Surge in 5xxs and request timeouts for text-gen endpoints in us-east-2 (hosted + dedicated mixed). Triggering on-call. Create incident thread for impact assessment and comms. :rotating_light:

leah (oncall): I'm on. Quick scope check: is this primarily hosted or hitting dedicated pools too?

rick (sre): Initial telemetry: both hosted and a couple of dedicated pools in us-east-2 show elevated p99 and ~1.5% 5xx. Spike started at 02:03 UTC. Root traces point to a client-side sudden retry storm (exponential backoff misconfigured) blasting the gateway, causing queue pile-ups and KV cache pressure. No node failures.

sofia (cs): Customers routed through affected pools: CypressHealth (CRITICAL, real-time clinical inference), Equinox Payments (HIGH, payments), Vantage Labs (MEDIUM, batch scoring). Need tailored notices and routing/PD plan.

amit (acct-eng): Routing & contacts (redacted):
- CypressHealth: sre-ops@cypress.health (PD if >0.5% errors for >4m)
- Equinox Payments: oncall@equinoxpay.com (PD preferred)
- Vantage Labs: ops@vantage.ai (email only)

rick (sre): Mitigation plan running now:
1) Engage gateway rate-limiter to cap per-IP QPS temporarily.
2) Temporarily disable automatic client retries at LB level for suspect prefixes.
3) Re-enable aggressive prefix KV sticky cache for top customer prefixes.
4) If errors persist for an enterprise prefix, perform targeted routing to us-east-1 fallback cluster for that prefix only.

leah (oncall): Applying rate limiter rule for 10m window to throttle noisy client ranges. Command: `redwoodctl gateway rate-limit --region us-east-2 --limit 1200rps --scope suspect-clients`

ops-bot: Rate limiter rule deployed by leah.

rick (sre): Disabling LB-level automatic retries for 30m for gen routes: `redwoodctl config set --service gen --retries.enabled false --region us-east-2`

sofia (cs): Draft customer-facing messages (please review). These are targeted and include expected ETA for stabilization.

- CypressHealth (CRITICAL): "We observed intermittent 5xx errors and increased latency affecting inference requests in us-east-2 beginning at 02:03 UTC. Our mitigation actions include request rate limiting at the gateway, temporary suppression of automated client retries, and sticky cache re-warm for critical prefixes. You may see occasional 5xxs or reduced throughput for the next ~10-30 minutes while caches stabilize. If you experience degradation that impacts clinical flows, reply to this thread or use your PD escalation."

- Equinox Payments (HIGH): "We detected transient 5xxs and high tail latency for some requests in us-east-2. We have applied rate limits and adjusted retry behavior to protect service stability. If you see payment-level failures, please escalate via your on-call PD immediately."

- Vantage Labs (MEDIUM): "Some batch scoring jobs may see retries or longer runtimes due to elevated backend load. We are applying protective limits and expect stabilization shortly; no action required unless failures persist."

amit (acct-eng): Holding PD messages until we confirm per-prefix improvement. I'll prepare protected PD content and send after canary.

rick (sre): Sticky cache warm started for top 150 prefixes including CypressHealth at 10% traffic as a canary. Observability link: https://metrics.redwood/incident/1960001111/canary

leah (oncall): Canary results: CypressHealth prefixes p99 dropped from ~2.6s to ~210ms and 5xxs to ~0.05% within 4 minutes. Expanding sticky cache to top 1000 prefixes and keeping retry suppression in place.

status-page-bot: Internal status page draft:
"Investigating elevated errors and latency in us-east-2. Engineers have applied gateway rate limiting, disabled automated LB retries, and warmed prefix caches. Service performance is improving; we will post updates within 15 minutes or as the situation evolves."

sofia (cs): Sending Equinox email and Vantage notice now. Amit, please send PD to CypressHealth once canary stable for 5m.

amit (acct-eng): PD ready. Sending to CypressHealth PD (redacted) now.

ops-bot: PD dispatched to CypressHealth on-call.

cypresshealth (external): "We see improved behavior, thank you. Please share RCA and whether any requests were lost." (simulated reply logged by cs)

leah (oncall): Observability: overall 5xxs down to 0.02% and p99 within SLO. Rolling retry suppression back to previous policy with graceful window: `redwoodctl config set --service gen --retries.enabled true --region us-east-2 --grace 300s`

rick (sre): Reintroducing retries now with grace window. Also adding follow-up automation: if kv_cache_eviction_rate > threshold -> automatically expand sticky cache and apply a temporary retry cap for 10m. Filing alert and automation ticket.

sofia (cs): Draft post-incident customer summary template (to be sent after RCA review): "Summary: Between 02:03-02:18 UTC, a client-side retry storm caused gateway queuing and elevated KV cache evictions in us-east-2, leading to transient 5xxs and increased latency. Actions taken: applied gateway rate limits, disabled LB retries temporarily, warmed sticky caches for critical prefixes, and routed individual prefixes to fallback clusters when necessary. Impact: brief degraded latency and low-frequency 5xxs for some customers (CypressHealth saw the largest impact). Resolution: mitigations restored normal service by ~02:18 UTC. Next steps: add pre-deploy checks for client-side retry config, alert on eviction spikes, and automate prefix-level fallback routing. Contact: support@redwood-inference.com or your account team."

amit (acct-eng): CypressHealth replied to PD: "Please include log bundle and a short sync; we need to show auditors." I'll prepare secure log bundle and schedule call.

leah (oncall): Assigning post-incident actions: rick -> RCA and alert + automation (owner), amit -> customer audit bundle + sync, sofia -> finalize customer templates and send RCAs. I'll own follow-up to add 'retry-storm' entry to incident playbook.

status-page-bot: Publishing public update: "Partial disruption in us-east-2 affecting inference endpoints; rate limiting and other mitigations applied. Service performance restored. Customers may have seen intermittent 5xxs between 02:03-02:18 UTC."

incident-bot: Incident resolved and archived. Please file RCA and customer artifacts within 24 hours. Reply 'reopen' to reopen. :white_check_mark:
